_comment: Example FLOW: the work states of a tube line (referenced by stations/example_tube_line.json; a flow may also be written inline in the station configuration). Each step is one work state: `expects` = what the line's own sensors claim, `verify` = the DLP check that confirms or corrects it (a recipe KEY of the active profile, so the same flow runs for long and short tubes; `observe` names the check whose answer IS the sensor's signal - here every recipe's seat/presence, so a tube that went missing at any step is a missing tube, never a dent), `permit` = the permission granted when it is CONFIRMED (bus output PERMIT_<NAME>). Outcomes: CONFIRMED (permission, next work state) | CORRECTED (the DLP disagrees with a sensor: on_mismatch) | NOT_MET (sensor and DLP agree, but not on what this step needs: on_not_met, default on_mismatch) | DEFECT (the part is there, a check fails: on_defect) | DOUBT (the DLP cannot tell: PULL, never a permission). Actions: project_fault | prompt <message> | hold | retry | kickout REJECT|PULL | goto <step>.
name: example_tube_line
description: Tube loaded? -> Tube aligned? -> End face OK?

steps.title: Tube loaded?

on_mismatch.prompt: no tube found: load or clear the sensor
a tube is on the seat but the sensor says none: check the sensor

on_defect: prompt the tube on the seat is not the selected profile's: change the tube or the profile

steps.title: Tube aligned?

on_mismatch.prompt: no tube found: load or clear the sensor
a tube is on the seat but the sensor says none: check the sensor

on_defect: prompt tube off its seat: re-seat it

steps.title: End face OK?

on_mismatch.prompt: no tube found: load or clear the sensor
a tube is on the seat but the sensor says none: check the sensor

on_defect: kickout REJECT end face not OK
